g.text: Working on several things at once
Each background task, and each extra chat on the same project, gets its own git worktree: two jobs never edit the same files.
your chat (main branch): you keep working
its own provider and model; keeps working
from a script or CI; returns at once
once, each with a fresh context;
the explorer can use its own model.
worktrees; the first that passes verify
merged one at a time through verify;
